findings.summary: Potential governance mismatch for R2/R3: requirements state missing or schema-invalid repo_context.json/workspace_context.json MUST fail the run, but the Intake tool_policy frames missing required inputs as a HITL trigger (interrupt) rather than an explicit fail/reject behavior. This is ambiguous for deterministic enforcement.

evidence.note: R2 specifies validators SHALL fail the run if repo_context.json is missing or schema-invalid.

evidence.note: R3 specifies validators SHALL fail the run if workspace_context.json is missing or schema-invalid.
evidence.quote: ...orchestrator validators SHALL fail the run if workspace_context.json is missing or schema-invalid...

findings.summary: R1 requires acceptance of plan_package_final.json plus an associated structured handoff bundle, but the requirement does not specify a typed/versioned schema for that handoff bundle (unlike R2/R3 which explicitly require typed/versioned schemas). This may leave enforcement underspecified.
